    • createClient

      @RequestMapping(method=POST, value="/api/admin/clients", produces={"application/json","application/problem+json"}, consumes="application/json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<CreatedClientResponse> createClient(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid ClientRequest clientRequest)
      POST /api/admin/clients : Creates a client The generated secret of a confidential client is returned only in this answer. Needs scope admin.
      Parameters:
      clientRequest - (required)
      Returns:
      The created client (status code 201) or Invalid definition (status code 400) or Missing or invalid bearer token (status code 401) or The token lacks the admin scope (status code 403) or The client identifier is already registered (status code 409)

    • deleteClient

      @RequestMapping(method=DELETE, value="/api/admin/clients/{clientId}", produces="application/problem+json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> deleteClient(@PathVariable("clientId") String clientId)
      DELETE /api/admin/clients/{clientId} : Deletes a client Needs scope admin.
      Parameters:
      clientId - Public identifier of the client. (required)
      Returns:
      Client deleted (status code 204) or Missing or invalid bearer token (status code 401) or The token lacks the admin scope (status code 403) or No such client (status code 404)

    • rotateClientSecret

      @RequestMapping(method=POST, value="/api/admin/clients/{clientId}/secret", produces={"application/json","application/problem+json"}) org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<ClientSecretResponse> rotateClientSecret(@PathVariable("clientId") String clientId)
      POST /api/admin/clients/{clientId}/secret : Rotates the secret of a confidential client The new secret is returned only in this answer. Needs scope admin.
      Parameters:
      clientId - Public identifier of the client. (required)
      Returns:
      The new secret (status code 200) or The client is public (status code 400) or Missing or invalid bearer token (status code 401) or The token lacks the admin scope (status code 403) or No such client (status code 404)

    • updateClient

      @RequestMapping(method=PUT, value="/api/admin/clients/{clientId}", produces={"application/json","application/problem+json"}, consumes="application/json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<ClientResponse> updateClient(@PathVariable("clientId") String clientId, @Valid @RequestBody @Valid ClientRequest clientRequest)
      PUT /api/admin/clients/{clientId} : Updates a client Replaces the definition of the client; the clientId of the body must match the path. The secret of the client is not changed. Needs scope admin.
      Parameters:
      clientId - Public identifier of the client. (required)
      clientRequest - (required)
      Returns:
      The updated client (status code 200) or Invalid definition, or a clientId in the body that differs from the path (status code 400) or Missing or invalid bearer token (status code 401) or The token lacks the admin scope (status code 403) or No such client (status code 404)
